## Summary

Describe the user-visible or architectural change and its motivation.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run package:npm` when package or entrypoint behavior changes
- [ ] Protocol types, schemas, fixtures, and ADRs agree when the wire contract changes
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, and artifacts contain no credentials, prompts, transcripts, or tool payloads
- [ ] Documentation reflects user-visible behavior
